slides.h1: The D-10 Pattern of Leaders Who Scale an Organisation
slides.sub: Running a team and scaling one are different skills. The career sub-chart can show the difference.

slides.body: This is an illustrative pattern from the classical method, not a chart of any named person. Without a documented birth time, pinning a pattern to a real chart would be guesswork.
The Dashamsha (D-10) is the career sub-chart, made by splitting each sign into ten parts. It is read after the main birth chart, never instead of it.

points: D-10 ascendant lord in dignity and in a kendra or trikona
10th lord and 11th lord linked — output joined to gains and network
Saturn, the planet of systems and large teams, well placed
The main chart's 10th house agrees, rather than contradicts

slides.h2: Run vs. scale, and when it shows
slides.body: A strong 10th house alone often points to mastery of one's own role. The 10th-11th link suggests the work compounds through other people. It tends to surface in the dasha of one of its own lords.
